assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original fantasy atlas background for the LEFT half of a dungeon adventure display, used beneath a live route overlay. Create a beautiful hand-drawn explorer's map on pale ivory parchment, wide landscape 3:2 composition. An entirely original unnamed realm: a winding river through an open central valley, small groups of ink-drawn pine forests around the edges, a few delicate mountain ridges near the upper corners, tiny ruined abbey, an old stone bridge and distant hills. Antique pen-and-ink cartography, confident fine black linework, sparse stipple, restrained pale ochre wash, high contrast and a mostly white paper base. Large open clear areas through the entire center for an overlaid winding journey trail and waypoint labels; terrain should be scenic but sparse, especially through the middle 70%. Small tasteful compass rose in a corner. Storybook epic fantasy mood, richly crafted rather than a generic map UI. NOT any existing fictional map: original coastline, landmarks and geography, no recognizable Tolkien/LOTR locations or symbols. No text, letters, numbers, routes, dots, border, UI, logo or watermark. Single map background, not a contact sheet. Designed to remain clear at 360 by 220 pixels and in monochrome. Opaque background.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished in-game scene illustration for the RIGHT half of One More Room, an original ambient fantasy dungeon adventure. Single wide landscape 16:9 image, not a sheet. Style: exquisite old-school fantasy adventure book illustration, pen-and-ink etching blended with restrained hand-painted washes, atmospheric perspective, dramatic but readable silhouettes, fine crosshatching and clean ivory highlights. Limited palette of charcoal black, warm ivory, amber lantern gold and a little deep brick red; no blue, neon or muddy gradients. Four recurring original heroes: Brann, a stocky bearded guardian with battered shield; Pip, a small nimble hooded rogue; Mira, a robed female mage with a pointed hood and staff; Fern, a ranger with bow and short travel cloak. Show the four as a coherent small adventuring party seen from behind or three-quarter view, not portraits, no extra party members. The lantern is their common source of light. Broad clear readable composition for a 360 by 155 pixel e-ink vignette: silhouettes and the main encounter should be strong, essential details centered and uncropped; avoid dense tiny details. Handcrafted, cinematic, wondrous, slightly mysterious, not cute cartoon stick figures, not photorealistic. No text, letters, UI, borders, logos or watermark. This is an entirely original world, no existing franchise characters. Opaque background. Scene: The company crosses a narrow old stone bridge through a vast ruined underground abbey. Carved arches, roots on pale stone, distant stairs spiraling down into mist, lantern light leading the way. A moment of exploration and discovery, no enemy present.
